paper_title: Improved Algorithms for Online Rent Minimization Problem Under Unit-Size Jobs
statement: Since the Online Rent Minimization problem is a generalization of the Online Machine Minimization problem, where we have an optimal e-competitive algorithm, one major question is: Is the Rent Minimization problem strictly harder than the Machine Minimization problem?
context: In conclusion, our main contribution is a 6-competitive algorithm for the Online Rent Minimization problem under unit-size jobs, which follows the oracle-based framework. Since the Online Rent Minimization problem is a generalization of the Online Machine Minimization problem, where we have an optimal e-competitive algorithm, one major question is: Is the Rent Minimization problem strictly harder than the Machine Minimization problem? On the other hand, we are also interested in the power of oracle-based algorithms. Note that the optimal e-competitive algorithm for Machine Minimization follows the oracle-based framework. It is interesting to ask: What is the best competitive ratio we can achieve for the Online Rent Minimization problem by using the oracle-based framework? The Semi-Online captures our current understanding of the possible range of optimal solutions, so replacing it with an optimal oracle cannot improve ratio directly by the same argument in the paper. Is it possible to obtain a better ratio with access to an optimal oracle?
